object.attr: as implemented: each parameter that reaches outside the repository lets a misled agent read or overwrite a person's files, so there are two. MELLON-MCP-SRS-113 narrows this. What each of the two may name is EDIT's and PDF's (review Q12).
object.description: The MCP server shall accept a path to a file outside the repository only in `set_figure`'s `source_path` and `export_document`'s `out_path`.
